context:
Before spawning rnd-cell I read the full charter and ran enginecheck. Two problems, both concrete: (1) the charter's own header says 'No
--exec spawn from atlas pane' and lifecycle.spawn_policy: no-exec-from-atlas-pane — it explicitly forbids the exact action I'd be
taking from this session. (2) enginecheck shows overall: FAIL — researcher would boot codex with no pinned model (not gpt-5.4-codex as
intended), planner would boot plain claude-opus-5 instead of a codex-family model (breaking the cross-family design entirely), only
message: verifier lands close to right, by a naming coincidence. How do you want to proceed?

options.label: Stop, don't spawn (Recommended) The charter itself says not to spawn from here, and 2 of 3 members would boot wrong regardless. Report this back to codex-fanout as the real reason, not a manufactured refusal.
Fix the charter first, then spawn Add explicit engine: fields (not just model:) so all three members resolve correctly, and address the no-exec-from-atlas-pane policy, before running maw team up.
Override and spawn anyway Proceed with maw team up despite the charter's own stated policy and the 2/3 wrong-engine result — you understand the risk and want it done regardless.
